headline: Full text of Jensen Huang’s memo to Nvidia employees
summary: Nvidia investigating CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a Chinese AI executive. Huang sent a memo to employees acknowledging the affair. The full text of the memo is now available.

headline: Soul Glo’s Diaspora Problems is a hardcore record like no other
summary: Soul Glo's 'Diaspora Problems' is hailed as a unique hardcore record. The band has a new album, 'NA I'M GON GRAB ALLAT,' set for January release. Reviewer praises previous works while anticipating the new drop.

headline: Epic Games Launcher is coming to SteamOS
summary: Epic Games Launcher will now support Valve's Linux-based SteamOS. This follows previous investigations into Fortnite compatibility. Compatibility with additional Linux distributions was also confirmed.

headline: Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy
summary: Nvidia launches an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang. The probe concerns his relationship with executive Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese spy. Board of directors announced an independent inquiry.

headline: Denis Villeneuve praises human creativity, teases new Bond film
summary: Director Denis Villeneuve champions human creativity over AI-generated prompts. He made comments hinting at a potential new James Bond project. Villeneuve's stance highlights art's human element.

headline: HoYoverse's 'Petit Planet' preview: A charming new Animal Crossing contender
summary: HoYoverse's 'Petit Planet' is a new cozy life-sim, drawing comparisons to Animal Crossing. Despite a crowded genre, the game's charm and detail stand out. An IGN preview highlights its potential to captivate players.

headline: Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair with alleged Chinese spy
summary: Nvidia has opened an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang. This follows his admission of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. The company is probing the nature of the relationship.

headline: Austin Butler's 'Miami Vice '85' Ferrari: The legal reason it's not black
summary: Set photos show Austin Butler driving a white Ferrari in 'Miami Vice '85.' This deviates from the iconic black Ferrari of the original series. A legal reason is speculated for the change in vehicle color.

headline: Allegations of sexual abuse made against Al Fayed's brother at Highland estate
summary: A woman alleges she was drugged and sexually abused. The alleged incidents occurred at the Fayed family's Balnagown estate. She claims to have been repeatedly assaulted after being flown there.

headline: Krakow doctor recounts treating shooting suspect, views all involved as victims
summary: A doctor who treated the Krakow shooting suspect shares his perspective. He emphasizes treating all involved, including the suspect, as victims. The shooting occurred near Krakow's Main Market Square.

headline: Dense fog threatens Monday morning commute disruption
summary: Dense fog is forecast to impact Monday morning's rush hour. Commuters are warned of potential travel disruptions. Visibility is expected to be significantly reduced.

headline: Maya Jama exits 'Love Island' hosting role, seeks new ventures
summary: Maya Jama announces her departure as host of 'Love Island.' She cites a desire to pursue 'something new' professionally. Her decision follows recent success on 'Celebrity Traitors.'
